_comment: How units sound just by being there (source/match/environment/Soundscape.gd). Each unit id names its presence layers; layers are loops mixed from every unit near the middle of the screen, nearer ones counting more. A layer plays its 'moving' loop for units on the move and its 'idle' loop (or the moving loop at idle_pitch) for units standing still, at the idle share of the loudness; idle 0 means the layer is silent at rest. Units missing here use 'default_vehicle'. Structures are not listed: they are buildings, not units. The loops come from tools/audio/make_unit_presence.py, make_war_sounds.py and make_soundscape.py.
_comment_chatter: now and then a unit of the player near the middle of the screen keys its radio: wordless chatter on the Voices bus, from where the unit is. More often as the fighting heats up (MusicPlayer state).
